items.text: Mudiwa wangu akanga ane munda wake wemizambiringa,
Ipapo akatarisa kuti awane zvibereko zvamazambiringa akanaka,
asi iwo wakangobereka muchero wakaipa chete.
"Zvino imi vagari vomuJerusarema nemi varume veJudha,
chitongai pakati pangu nomunda wemizambiringa wangu.
Chiiko chimwezve chaifanira kuitirwa munda wangu
Zvino akatarisira kururamisira asi akaona kuteuka kweropa;
akatsvaka kururuma, asi akanzwa kuchema kwokutambudzika.
Mune nhamo imi munowedzera dzimba nedzimba
Jehovha Wamasimba Ose akataura ndichinzwa akati,
Maeka gumi omunda wemizambiringa achabereka bhati rimwe chete
asi havana hanya namabasa aJehovha, havana rukudzo nebasa ramaoko ake.
uye rakazarura muromo waro zvinodarika mwero;
Asi Jehovha Wamasimba Ose achakudzwa, nokuda kwokururamisira kwake, uye Mwari,
mutsvene achazviratidza pachake kuti mutsvene, mukururama kwake.
Ipapo makwai achafura saari mumafuro awo;
Vane nhamo avo vanokweva chivi nerwodzi rwokunyengera,
vanoisa rima panzvimbo yechiedza nechiedza panzvimbo yerima,
Vane nhamo avo vanoti vakachenjera pameso avo,
Vane nhamo avo vanova mhare pakunwa waini,
uye souswa hwakaoma hunomedzwa nemirazvo yemoto,
nokuti vakaramba murayiro waJehovha Wamasimba Ose,
Naizvozvo kutsamwa kwaJehovha kwopfuta pamusoro pavanhu vake;
ruoko rwake rwasimudzwa uye anovarovera pasi.
uye mitumbi yavakafa yaita samarara mumigwagwa.
kutsamwa kwake hakuna kudzorwa, ruoko rwake rwaramba rwakasimudzwa.
anoridzira muridzo kuna avo vari kumigumo yenyika.
Hapana kana mumwe wavo anoneta kana kugumburwa,
hapana kana mumwe wavo achakotsira kana kuvata;
